_comment: Copy this file to numbers.json, then either run pull_smrtphone_numbers.py --commit to auto-fill the numbers array from your SmrtPhone account, or type your numbers in by hand. number = E.164 (+1XXXXXXXXXX). added = the date the number went live (drives the 3-week warm-up ramp; for numbers that have been dialing for a while, backdate it so they score as ACTIVE). caller = optional label for who dials on it.

telnyx._note: OPTIONAL Telnyx L2 (carrier-grade reputation). Leave empty unless you completed the Telnyx upgrade in telnyx_setup.py. enterprise_id is written here by `telnyx_setup.py register`, or read from TELNYX_ENTERPRISE_ID in .env.

registration._note: Free Caller Registry tracking. Set submitted (YYYY-MM-DD) after you submit at freecallerregistry.com; recheck_by auto-fills to +90 days as a quarterly re-verify reminder (NOT a renewal). Flip each carrier engine to 'confirmed' as its acknowledgement email arrives.
